Bug_Title: DMI: Double.longBitsToDouble invoked on an int (DMI_LONG_BITS_TO_DOUBLE_INVOKED_ON_INT)
Bug_Details:
The Double.longBitsToDouble method is invoked, but a 32 bit int value is passed
    as an argument. This almost certainly is not intended and is unlikely
    to give the intended result.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by invoking the Double.longBitsToDouble method with an int value instead of a long value. This is incorrect usage as the method expects a long argument representing the bit pattern of a double value.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method with an integer value, which triggers the bug by invoking Double.longBitsToDouble with an int instead of a long.
